description:
About the job

Responsibilities

Team Introduction

The e-commerce industry has grown tremendously recently, becoming a hotly contested space among leading Internet companies. Its future growth cannot be underestimated.

With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our campaign team. Together, we can build an e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure, and intuitive for our users.

Step into a dynamic role with the Mexico operation team, where you'll play a vital part in executing varies campaigns for some of the most iconic brands. Be at the forefront of innovation, contributing to cutting-edge campaigns and driving forward the yearly strategic modules that define success. In this role, you’ll help power the future of e-commerce, supporting high-impact initiatives that connect brands with consumers in meaningful ways. Join us as we shape the future of e-commerce here at TikTok Shop!

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early.

Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 3 months long internship period.

Responsibilities:

Creator Hunting & Identification (Stage 1)


 Identify and source high-potential fashion creators across TikTok and other social platforms, focusing on those with strong content quality, audience engagement, and commercial potential.
 Analyze creator profiles, content style, audience demographics, and performance metrics to assess fit within - TikTok Shop’s fashion ecosystem.
 Build and maintain a robust pipeline of creators segmented by category (e.g., apparel, footwear, accessories) and content type (live, video, product-driven).


Creator Incubation & Fashion Alignment (Stage 2)


 Support the onboarding and incubation of selected creators by helping define their initial content and monetization strategy.
 Identify and match relevant fashion brands, products, and merchandising strategies based on each creator’s profile, audience, and content style.
 Collaborate with Account Managers to guide creators on best practices for live streaming, product selection, and content optimization.
 Monitor creator development and track their progression from early-stage incubation to revenue-generating contributors.


Performance Tracking & Insights


 Track and analyze both qualitative and quantitative performance metrics, including GMV contribution, content performance, conversion rates, and creator growth.
 Build and maintain dashboards or trackers to measure the effectiveness of the creator incubation program.
 Generate insights on what works (e.g., creator archetypes, product categories, content formats) to continuously refine the strategy.


Project Management & Cross-functional Collaboration


 Support the execution of the creators project roadmap, ensuring timelines and deliverables are met.
 Work closely with Account Managers, marketing, and operations teams to align on creator strategies and opportunities.
 Contribute to continuous improvement of creator sourcing, incubation frameworks, and scaling strategies.


Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications


 Currently pursuing an Undergraduate/Master in Business or a related fields
 Proactive self-learner, open to navigating uncertain and exploratory business scenarios.
 Applicants are kindly requested to submit an English-language resume.


Preferred Qualifications


 Strong analytical skills, with a structured and critical approach to problem-solving;
 Experience in commerce platforms, digital marketing, or the short video/live streaming industry is highly valued.


Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

TikTok Accommodation

TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA-request

description:
About the job

The IKEA vision is to create a better everyday life for the many people. We do this by offering a wide range of well-designed, functional home furnishing products at prices so low that as many people as possible can afford them. We operate in Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand – and have an ambitious expansion plan to bring a little bit of Sweden to new markets in the region. We are part of the Ikano Group of companies and the only IKEA franchisee owned by the Kamprad family that founded IKEA.



We also develop, own and operate Shopping Centres that are anchored by IKEA and create walkable communities by including residential, office and other types of real estate in our development plans.



We work towards making sustainability a natural part of our everyday work. We are active in our communities, driving and supporting social initiatives that benefit children, women and the environment.





Job Description

Passionate about online media and home furnishing with strong curiosity about consumers, markets and trends. 
Highly collaborative with a strong sense of ‘togetherness’ to achieve the goal.

Knowledge of photoshop / In-design / and other job-related software to facilitate simple video or animated content production. 
Knowledge of social media platforms guidelines and understanding of media. 
Knowledge of search engine marketing and optimisation, understanding of technicalities, and insights to online traffic generation. 
Knowledge of trends, proven solutions, translating global into local market relevant/regional solutions that influence home furnishing and retailing. 
Knowledge of customers' living situations as well as their needs and frustrations in their everyday life at home in order to translate that into strong messaging. 
Knowledge of IKEA concept, brand objectives, values and vision, tone of voice. 
Budgetary experience – evaluate, monitor, follow-up and adjust as needed. 
Strong multi-tasking skills to work in a fast-moving environment and meet tight deadlines. 
Possess a creative mindset and ability to challenge common ways of thinking. 
Flair for copy writing with IKEA’s twinkle in the eye messages with good eye for creatives, image selection and layouts. 
Driven by generating efficiencies, customer insights, trends and media effectiveness. 
Possess analytical skills to follow up and measure performance of output and capture learnings to improve and moving forward. 
Ability to understand the complexity of IKEA business and the role of commerciality as an integrated part of the business.

Create a trustful and creative environment.

description:
About the job

Influencer Marketing Specialist




⭐ About the role

Our client is a fast-growing, New York-based influencer marketing agency working with a diverse portfolio of consumer brands, including skincare, financial services, and retail clients. On their behalf, we're looking for a highly organized, detail-obsessed Influencer Marketing Specialist to join their Campaign team and own the day-to-day execution of influencer marketing campaigns.




This is very much a "doer" role: once strategy is locked in with the client, you're the person making it happen, reaching out to creators, following up on negotiations, getting contracts signed, and keeping every campaign moving on time. You won't be leading client strategy calls; you'll be the engine behind the scenes that makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.




What you'll do

📌 Influencer Sourcing & Outreach

Identify and vet the right creators across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and emerging platforms, using both tools and manual research
Ensure creators are a strong brand and audience fit for each client
Own outreach, rate negotiation, contracting, and follow-up through to signed deals
Stay on top of creator trends and emerging talent

📌 Campaign Execution & Coordination

Manage detailed timelines and workflows so every campaign milestone hits its deadline
Track and report status clearly (e.g., "reached out to 20 creators today, here's where each one stands, here's the contract negotiation stage")
Review and approve content submissions against brand and legal requirements
Keep everything organized across multiple campaigns and clients running in parallel

📌 Reporting & Optimization

Support post-campaign performance analysis and reporting
Flag optimization opportunities in real time based on results and platform changes

📌 Collaboration

Work closely with the Campaign Lead and internal team members handling other parts of the campaign (tech, process)
No direct reports, this is an individual contributor role




🔍 What we're looking for

2+ years of hands-on experience executing influencer marketing campaigns, ideally within an agency environment (not in-house)
Prior experience with influencer/creator sourcing and talent negotiation is a strong plus, this is a meaningful part of the role
Excellent written and spoken English, you'll be communicating directly with creators and their agents via email and DM
Self-driven and highly organized, with real attention to detail, you can own a process end-to-end without close supervision
Comfortable managing multiple campaigns and clients simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
A fun, creative, "how can we make this happen" attitude, this team doesn't like telling clients no
Familiarity with tools like Google Suite, Canva, and Asana is a plus




📍 Location & hours: Remote, open to candidates across LATAM. Sould be able to work primarily on US Eastern / Central time.

title: Digital Marketing Analyst
description:
About the job

It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing!

NEOGEN Digital Marketing Analyst support our LATAM digital marketing team. The responsibilities will include social media management for our LATAM accounts, it is Facebook, LinkedIn, and Instagram; execute campaign strategies and create marketing digital assets as email templates, forms, and landing pages on Eloqua (marketing automation), SEO, website optimization and maintenance. This role will also be responsible for assign new leads to sales representant on Salesforce CRM; collect and analyze data from social media, google and Eloqua for digital reports.

The Marketing Automation Specialist is responsible for creating and developing content for forms, landing pages, and email templates within Eloqua, supporting website design, development, and planning, and executing marketing campaigns across multiple digital channels. This role manages lead generation and lead routing processes, supports content ecosystem administration through platforms such as Bynder and Seismic, and monitors marketing KPIs and campaign performance to optimize results.

The position requires maintaining consistency and compliance with brand guidelines, messaging, and approved materials, using only content validated by marketing, technical, and legal stakeholders to ensure traceability and compliance. The incumbent is also responsible for keeping Quality Management System (QMS) documentation up to date, contributing to preventive actions and continuous process improvements, and maintaining an organized and compliant work environment.

In alignment with Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) standards, the employee is expected to use all applicable personal and collective protective equipment, maintain an appropriate workstation, take active breaks, and manage workloads to support personal health and performance.

The successful candidate demonstrates and embodies Neogen's Pillars of Trust—Openness, Honesty, Credibility, Respect, and Service—through all actions, behaviors, and communications. They communicate effectively, actively listen, lead by example, foster teamwork and trust, make timely decisions, solve problems efficiently, and drive performance through accountability, productivity, and innovation. They also understand their role within the broader organization and remain curious about how their work contributes to business success.

Qualifications include a college degree, preferably a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, with at least one year of relevant experience (two years preferred). Candidates should possess knowledge of marketing principles, Microsoft Office applications, CRM systems, and marketing automation platforms, with experience in Eloqua and Salesforce preferred. Additional expertise in digital marketing, Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics, UX/UI design, SEO, SEM, marketing analytics, business intelligence tools, and reporting is highly desirable. An intermediate to advanced level of English is required.

Come Be Part Of A Mission that Matters!

From inside the farm gate to our dinner plates, Neogen protects the world’s food supply. Through a variety of animal healthcare products, to food safety solutions for dangerous bacteria, allergens, toxins, drug residues and much more, Neogen is there — and you can be too.

About the job

Reports to: Senior Customer Excellence Manager

Why this role matters

As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you’ll be the vital link between ICEYE’s SAR satellite capabilities and our customers across the LATAM region — ensuring every order, from submission to final delivery, runs smoothly and every customer interaction leaves a lasting impression.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world’s largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your Day-to-day Responsibilities

Regular Customer Excellence Responsibilities

Order Management


Oversee the entire order process, from submission to the delivery of the final product.
Prepare comprehensive feasibility studies for satellite imagery, ensuring customer requirements are met.


Satellite Resource Planning


Plan satellite resources for capturing Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images.
Perform SAR image quality control to maintain high standards.


Customer Interaction


Resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (satellite operators, sales, analytics, product software) to address project and customer-related issues.
Serve as a vital interface between clients and ICEYE, ensuring effective communication and interaction.


Process Improvement


Contribute to the enhancement of existing processes and documentation.
Report to management on key performance metrics and anomalies.


Product Knowledge


Maintain a thorough understanding of the company’s products, support, and services.


Account Management Responsibilities

Governmental and Commercial Contracts:


Serve as the point of contact for governmental contracts and commercial clients.
Conduct feasibility studies and effectively communicate results to customers.


Relationship Building


Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers, serving as a key contact for order-related queries.


Training And Progress Monitoring


Coordinate and conduct service training for both internal and external customers.
Monitor order progress closely, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues.


Reporting


Satisfy internal and external reporting needs by providing accurate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).


What We’re Looking For


Bachelor’s degree in Geography, Remote Sensing, Aerospace, or a related field.
Proven experience in a customer excellence, account management, or customer-facing operations role.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills,Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Availability for shift work (no night shifts required).


Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)


Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.


Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

The Demand Specialist plays a critical role in aligning customer demand with operational execution by serving as a strategic liaison between customers, Supply Chain, and Customer Success organization. description:
About the job

Description

We are looking for a Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to join the Amazon Payments Mexico marketing team. In this role, you will serve as the single-threaded owner of marketing execution for one or more payment products within the Amazon Mexico ecosystem. You will be responsible for converting marketing strategy into customer-facing outcomes through hands-on, week-by-week execution across onsite merchandising, promotions, performance reporting, and competitive intelligence.

This is a high-ownership, high-velocity role where you will manage the full execution lifecycle — from campaign creation and promotional configuration to post-campaign analysis — operating within Amazon's rigorous weekly business review cadence.

Key job responsibilities

Onsite Merchandising

Own all customer-facing placements on Amazon.com.mx including Maple campaigns (High Upsell Cards, Mobile View Cards, Priceblock banners, Wallet placements), DPIC content, Sparkle keyword campaigns, homepage hero banners, and landing pages

Manage creative briefing, review, scheduling coordination, and multi-channel QA across mobile, app, and desktop

Execute large-scale campaign rotations during High-Velocity Events (40+ onsite campaigns and 5–8 landing pages per event)

Configure targeting by card issuer and customer segment

Promotions & Discounts

Design promotional strategies for assigned payment products and navigate approval workflows with Finance and Legal

Configure promotions in relevant systems (PAWS, IBD coupon architecture, cashback configurations)

Coordinate with up to 14 issuing bank partners on offer structures, communication timing, and shared funding

Maintain a rolling pipeline of promotions planned quarters ahead and deliver post-promotion ROI reporting

Monitoring & Reporting

Produce weekly flash reports, WBR/MBR data pulls, and monthly deep-dive analyses

How will you contribute to our magical experience?

At Disney, we believe it takes great people to create memorable experiences, products and services our consumers know and love. description:
About the job

Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

México was Tilt’s first market outside the US. Launched in 2022, we’ve already helped thousands of customers access fair credit in moments of need — using alternative data and technology to serve those often overlooked by traditional lenders. We’re scaling rapidly and preparing to launch new products that will expand our reach and deepen our impact across the country.

The Opportunity: Performance Marketing Manager

We are seeking a Performance Marketing Manager to scale our mobile acquisition engine in Mexico. We've already built a live, growing business - and we're investing significantly to accelerate it. This role is responsible for deploying, measuring, and optimizing a multimillion-dollar advertising budget across channels such as Meta, Google App Campaigns, and DSPs.

This role sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and execution. You will operate as both a hands-on media buyer and a highly analytical problem solver, owning performance end-to-end, from campaign setup to deep funnel optimization.

As the first dedicated performance marketing hire on Mexico, you'll partner with our existing agency while progressively bringing knowledge and capabilities in-house - with real traction already behind you and a mandate to push it much further.

This is a remote role with a preference for individuals based in México or in a similar time zone. Occasional travel will be required for company onsites and market visits (minimum 4-6 times per year).

How You'll Make An Impact


Own paid acquisition end-to-end across mobile channels (Meta, Google App Campaigns, DSPs, and others), including campaign setup, optimization, and scaling.
Own and mature the performance marketing function - building out processes, reporting, and experimentation frameworks on top of an already-live, scaling business.
Manage and develop our agency relationship, extracting knowledge, building internal capabilities, and progressively owning more of the execution in-house.
Optimize for full-funnel performance, from impression to repayment behavior - improving CAC, conversion rates, and LTV.
Design and run rigorous experiments (A/B tests, incrementality tests, creative testing) to continuously improve performance, even in low-signal environments.
Allocate and optimize budget dynamically based on performance, risk, and business priorities.
Drive creative strategy and iteration, translating performance data into actionable insights on messaging, formats, and audiences.
Partner cross-functionally with Product, Risk, Analytics, and Design to improve targeting, onboarding flows, and conversion.
Own mobile attribution and measurement, working with tools like AppsFlyer/Adjust and navigating signal loss (e.g., SKAN, privacy changes).
Develop deep expertise in the Mexico market - including channel dynamics, user behavior, payment patterns, and regulatory considerations - and use it to inform strategy.


Why You're a Great Fit


5–7 years of hands-on experience in mobile performance marketing, with ownership of campaign performance.
Proven track record managing and scaling app acquisition campaigns on platforms like Meta, Google App Campaigns, or DSPs.
Experience optimizing beyond installs, using downstream metrics (e.g., activation, conversion, revenue, LTV) to drive decisions.
Familiarity with mobile attribution tools (e.g., AppsFlyer) and challenges related to signal loss (e.g., SKAN).
Strong analytical skills; ability to connect marketing performance to business outcomes (CAC, LTV, payback).
Experience working with SQL to analyze performance and generate insights independently.
High level of ownership and comfort with ambiguity - able to build structure and drive results in a fast-scaling environment.
Strong communication skills; able to influence cross-functional stakeholders with data.
Fluency in Spanish and English


Nice to Have


Experience in FinTech, lending, or credit-focused businesses
Experience in Mexico or other emerging markets
Experience with incrementality testing
Familiarity with creative strategy at scale (UGC, iteration frameworks)
Experience with DSPs and programmatic buying
Experience optimizing for down-funnel outcomes such as approvals and repayment behavior


Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Get At Tilt


Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.
Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.
Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.
Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.
Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)
Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.


The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

title: Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
About the job

Acerca de Emeritus

En Emeritus creemos que los líderes construyen del mundo un lugar mejor. Nuestra misión es democratizar el acceso a educación de clase mundial, colaborando con las mejores escuelas de negocio del planeta — MIT Sloan, Columbia Business School, Tuck School of Business, entre otras. Ofrecemos cursos, certificados y maestrías en inglés, español, mandarín y portugués, impactando a más de 300,000 estudiantes en +100 países.




Acerca del Puesto

El Marketing Automation Specialist será el arquitecto de los flujos de comunicación digital que guían a los prospectos desde el primer intento de contacto hasta la inscripción en programas de Emeritus. Esta persona será responsable de diseñar, implementar y optimizar journeys automatizados en Salesforce Marketing Cloud, gestionar campañas multicanal (email y WhatsApp), y medir el impacto de cada acción con KPIs claros.

El rol requiere una mentalidad analítica y orientada a resultados: entender el origen y comportamiento de los prospectos, explorar patrones de interacción, detectar oportunidades de mejora y colaborar con equipos de Performance, Ventas y Producto para maximizar la tasa de inscripción.




Funciones Principales

1. Diseño e Implementación de Flujos Automatizados

• Mapear y comprender las fuentes de prospectos (paid media, orgánico, referidos, alianzas) y sus comportamientos para diseñar customer journeys relevantes.

• Diseñar, construir y lanzar flujos automatizados en Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio) alineados a cada etapa del funnel.

• Definir lógicas de segmentación, personalización y ramificaciones basadas en comportamiento (aperturas, clics, formularios, tiempo en el funnel).

• Proponer y desarrollar nuevas automatizaciones para mejorar la conversión y la eficiencia operativa del equipo.

• Coordinar con redactores y diseñadores para solicitar los copies y materiales necesarios para cada flujo.




2. Gestión de Campañas y Envíos

• Ejecutar campañas automatizadas y envíos manuales (email y WhatsApp) garantizando correcta segmentación, personalización y calendarización.

• Configurar templates responsivos y asegurar su correcta renderización en múltiples clientes de correo.

• Dar seguimiento a indicadores clave: open rate, CTR, entregabilidad, tasa de bajas y conversión.

• Generar insights accionables a partir del análisis de resultados para iterar y mejorar campañas de forma continua.




3. Medición, Análisis y Optimización con KPIs

• Definir y monitorear KPIs de cada flujo automatizado: tasa de apertura, tasa de conversión por etapa, costo por lead calificado, tiempo promedio en el funnel.

• Generar reportes periódicos de desempeño de campañas y journeys con análisis comparativo.

• Proponer y ejecutar pruebas A/B (asunto, copy, horario de envío, CTA) para optimizar resultados.

• Identificar cuellos de botella en los flujos y proponer mejoras basadas en datos para incrementar el número de inscritos.

• Colaborar en la construcción de dashboards de seguimiento con el equipo de BI o Performance.




4. Gestión de Landing Pages y Contenido

• Desarrollar y publicar landing pages en Contentful (CMS), asegurando alineación con lineamientos de marca y objetivos de conversión.

• Coordinar la correcta implementación de materiales digitales (banners, formularios, UTMs).

• Colaborar en la generación de contenido para campañas (email, WhatsApp, LP) con enfoque en conversión.




5. Coordinación y Trabajo en Equipo

• Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de Performance, Ventas y Producto para alinear flujos con objetivos comerciales.

• Apoyar en la ejecución de materiales y campañas para lanzamientos de nuevos programas.

• Gestionar solicitudes derivadas de flujos automatizados (leads, materiales, LPs) con agilidad y criterio.

• Participar activamente en reuniones de planeación, retrospectivas y sesiones de mejora continua.




KPIs de Éxito del Rol

KPI / Métrica Objetivo / Referencia

Tasa de apertura de emails ≥ 25% promedio en flujos clave

Click-Through Rate (CTR) ≥ 3% en campañas de nurturing

Tasa de conversión por etapa del funnel Mejora trimestral sostenida

Número de inscritos generados por flujos automatizados Meta definida por campaña/programa

Entregabilidad de emails ≥ 95% (spam rate < 0.1%)

Tiempo de implementación de nuevos flujos < 5 días hábiles para flujos estándar

Uptime de journeys activos 99% sin interrupciones no planificadas

NPS interno (satisfacción de equipos

colaboradores) ≥ 4/5 trimestral




Requisitos del Candidato

Educación y Experiencia

• Licenciatura en Comunicación, Mercadotecnia, Publicidad, Sistemas o afín.

• Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en Marketing Automation, CRM o Email Marketing.

• Experiencia comprobable con Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder).

• Experiencia en diseño y análisis de flujos de comunicación automatizada orientados a conversión.




Habilidades Técnicas

• Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC): Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio — nivel avanzado.

• Conocimiento de AMPscript o SQL para personalización dinámica de contenido (deseable).

• HTML y CSS para maquetación de emails responsivos.

• Manejo de plataformas de mensajería: WhatsApp Business API o similares.

• CMS: Contentful o equivalente para gestión de landing pages.

• Dominio de MS Office / Google Workspace; Excel avanzado para análisis de datos.

• Inglés intermedio-avanzado (lectura de documentación técnica y comunicación con equipos globales).




Competencias Clave

• Pensamiento analítico y orientado a datos — toma de decisiones basada en métricas.

• Visión de funnel — capacidad de entender el recorrido del prospecto de inicio a fin.

• Atención al detalle — cero errores en envíos masivos y configuración de journeys.

• Proactividad — capacidad de identificar oportunidades de mejora sin esperar instrucciones.

• Trabajo en equipo y comunicación efectiva con áreas multidisciplinarias.

• Autogestión y manejo del tiempo en modalidad 100% home office.

• Orientación a resultados — enfoque constante en incrementar el número de inscritos.




Deseable (Nice to Have)

• Certificación en Salesforce Marketing Cloud (Email Specialist o Marketing Cloud Consultant).

• Experiencia en sector EdTech o empresas de suscripción con funnels de conversión complejos.

• Conocimiento de herramientas de analytics: GA4, Looker Studio, Tableau o Power BI.

• Experiencia con pruebas A/B y metodologías de optimización de conversión (CRO).

• Conocimiento básico de APIs REST para integración de fuentes de prospectos.




¿Por qué unirte a Emeritus?

• Impacto real: tus flujos automatizados conectarán a miles de profesionales con las mejores universidades del mundo.

• Crecimiento acelerado: empresa global en expansión con oportunidades de desarrollo internacional.

• Tecnología de punta: trabajarás con Salesforce Marketing Cloud en escala real de LATAM.

• Equipo de alto desempeño: colaborarás con expertos en performance, ventas y producto.

• Flexibilidad: 100% home office con horarios estables y cultura orientada a resultados.

• Prestaciones superiores: IMSS completo + Seguro de Vida + Gastos Médicos Mayores desde el día 1.

About the job

About PayJoy

PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success. Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system. Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life. PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.

This role

The Strategy & Performance Analyst supports the Managers in executing key country-level and global initiatives. The role ensures strategic priorities translate into execution through cross-functional coordination and performance tracking. It delivers actionable insights to leadership, enabling data-driven decision-making and business alignment.

Key Responsibilities


 Contribute to the design and execution of strategic initiatives, ensuring clear alignment with business goals and measurable progress over time.

 Conduct strategic research and competitive benchmarking to inform decision-making and uncover growth opportunities. 
 Design and maintain dashboards and reports to support deeper analysis, standardize reporting processes, and ensure data accuracy. 
 Document recurring processes that enable consistent performance tracking.

WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.




WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

The Talent Acquisition Assessment Analyst will join Bain’s Talent Acquisition Global Assessment Center of Excellence (CoE) supporting the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Bain’s global assessment strategy. The analyst will partner closely with stakeholders across the Global Talent Acquisition team to provide robust assessment reporting and insights, support the evolution of Bain’s interview assessments, including AI-enabled interview materials and contribute to the advancement of digital assessment tools.
